name: HWR_XP_SKILLS_B
description: This table will be used to store discovered skills from the experience store.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This represents the Fusion id of the user for which this skill was found.

columns.name: SKILL_ID
columns.description: This is the unique identifier for the corresponding skill.

columns.name: VERB_ID
columns.description: This is the unique identifier for the corresponding verb.

columns.name: SCORE
columns.description: SCORE Normalized claculation of the relevance score of skill.

columns.name: RAW_SCORE
columns.description: RAW_SCORE Raw calculation of the relevance score of skill.

columns.name: IS_SEEDED
columns.description: This indicates whether the skill was seeded or not seeded.

columns.name: XP_SKILLS_ATTR_1
columns.description: XP_SKILLS_ATTR_1. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: XP_SKILLS_ATTR_2
columns.description: XP_SKILLS_ATTR_2. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: XP_SKILLS_ATTR_3
columns.description: XP_SKILLS_ATTR_3. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: XP_SKILLS_ATTR_4
columns.description: XP_SKILLS_ATTR_4. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
